# Automation Blueprint by Asendify

> Automation Blueprint (https://automate.asendify.co) turns a plain-words description of any business automation into a professional, buildable blueprint. Fully automatic: describe it, pay, and the blueprint is ready within minutes on a private page that is also emailed. Made by Asendify.

## Key facts
- What you get: a workflow diagram (trigger, steps, apps and branches; download as PNG or SVG, plus a Mermaid text copy), the recommended automation platform and the tool for each step with the reason, numbered step-by-step build instructions, the data passed between steps, error handling, what you need before you start, how to test it, difficulty, time to build and an estimated monthly tool cost range.
- Tools it can recommend: n8n, Make, Zapier, Google Sheets, Airtable, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, Stripe, Typeform, Calendly, Notion, Shopify, Xero, QuickBooks, OpenAI, Anthropic and similar.
- Price: £217.50 per blueprint (£150 + 45% service fee of £67.50). One-time payment through PayPal. No subscription. Nothing is free (no free trial or free sample blueprint), but a full example is public.
- How it is made: an AI model writes the blueprint to a strict structure and the system checks it automatically before the buyer sees it. Cost figures are estimates; tool prices change.
- It is a blueprint, not a build service: buyers build it themselves or hand it to any developer.
- Example (fictional business): https://automate.asendify.co/example/
- Policies (payments and refunds): https://www.asendify.co/policies/

## Every feature, by name
- Describe it in plain words: up to 3,000 characters: what starts it, what should happen and where the result goes
- Build around your tools: list the tools you already use and the blueprint uses them
- Budget setting: under £50, £50–200, £200–500 or over £500 a month, or not sure
- Technical level setting: not technical, some no-code experience, or comfortable with code and APIs
- Workflow diagram: the trigger, every step, AI steps, decisions (branches) and outputs, with the app for each
- Download the diagram: as PNG or SVG
- Mermaid code: copy the diagram as Mermaid text
- Main platform recommendation: for example n8n, Make or Zapier, with the reason it fits you
- Tools for each step: what each tool does in the workflow, why it was picked and its rough cost
- Numbered build steps: exact instructions for each step, including the nodes or modules and settings
- Data in and data out: what each step receives and passes on, so the fields line up
- Error handling: what can go wrong (rate limits, bad data, failed AI output, duplicates) and how to handle it
- Before you start: the accounts, API keys and access you need
- Assumptions: what the blueprint assumed about your setup
- Test it before going live: a testing checklist
- Difficulty: Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced
- Time to build: an estimate in hours
- Monthly cost estimate: a low–high range in GBP, with what drives the cost
- Automatic quality checks: the diagram must have a trigger, every step must connect and there must be no loops; failed drafts are rewritten (up to 3 attempts)
- Works with mainstream tools: n8n, Make, Zapier, Google Sheets, Airtable, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, Stripe, Typeform, Tally, Calendly, Notion, Shopify, Xero, QuickBooks, OpenAI and Anthropic
- Fully automatic: no calls and no waiting for someone to reply
- Ready in minutes: the page updates by itself when the blueprint is done
- Private link: a long random link only you and the people you share it with can open
- Emailed to you: the private link is also sent to your email
- Hand it to anyone: build it yourself or give it to any developer or automation freelancer
- Full example to read first: a complete example blueprint is on the site
- One-time price: £217.50 per blueprint, no subscription

## Who Automation Blueprint is for
- Small business owners, founders and agencies who know what they want automated but not how to build it.
- People who want a plan to hand to a developer or automation freelancer before paying for the build.
- No-code builders who want the right platform, tools, steps and error handling laid out for one workflow.

## Who it's not for
- Anyone who wants the automation built and running for them: this product is the blueprint, not the build.
- People who need exact tool prices: the costs are estimates, and providers change their plans.
- Projects that need a live consultation or ongoing support: it is fully automatic, with no calls.
